designVerdict: SELECTED as C33 - the 36 V bulk at the USB-C inlet. 2.2 uF 100 V X7R 1210.
notes: 2.2 uF rather than a second 4.7 uF, and the reason is the USB Type-C sink bypass limit of 10 uF. At attach the bus is at vSafe5V and both eFuses are off, so what counts is C33 + C8 + C9 + C3 + C4. With two 4.7 uF that is 10.06 uF nameplate - and at 5 V on 100 V-rated X7R there is almost no DC-bias derating to hide behind, so effective is near nameplate and the design would be just outside a limit it claims to respect. 2.2 uF brings the total to 7.56 uF.
The bulk that matters for the converter is C8, which stays at 4.7 uF. C33 exists for the connector transient at the inlet, where 2.2 uF is ample.
